learning.candidate_gate: current correct gain >=1/48; historical losses <=2/72 per decision; format >=0.95; report cumulative losses
learning.memory: full original feedback, raw/abstract/skill consolidation; gated commit
learning.graph_scope: All VQA train, selection, historical VQA anchors, development and confirmation use graph; other-task anchors preserve original direct coordinate-safe interface

initialization.fresh: empty memory; adaptive applicability and train-derived tool statistics
initialization.reference: empty memory; previous exact-question visual-reference method

learning.execution_change: Controller sees only visible question, schema and observations; tools/final answer receive learned HCL guidance. Explicit finalize node; no model weight change.
learning.note: Inherited adapter configuration only: this experiment does not call HCL.train. It fits a separate stopping-policy candidate from training counterfactual pairs.

development.use: parent development not used for candidate acceptance; new selection24 allocated

confirmation.primary: policy versus full, normalized exact match and fixed failure denominator; report paired gain/loss/CI and actual calls
confirmation.conditional_on: candidate accepted on new selection24 and historical72
confirmation.ci: 20000 paired bootstrap draws, seed20261116; McNemar two-sided exact

shared_answer_interface: same shortest answer / digits for count / semicolon for multiple items; no answer vocabulary; different from old experiments
limitations: Counterfactual stopping mechanism study built on a previously learned frozen state, not new model-weight training.
48 training pairs and 24 acceptance cases are small; support is empirical, not calibrated probability.
Early stopping policy is a finite learned rule over coarse visible features; tools and controller share one frozen VLM.
Training images are intentionally reused from the parent; new selection and confirmation source/pixel groups exclude all prior experiments.
Patient independence unverified; official test unused.
If the policy gate rejects, no independent confirmation is opened and no improvement is claimed.
purpose: Learn a visible-observation stopping policy from matched one-versus-two-tool training rollouts, gate it, then independently confirm only if accepted; this is a mechanism experiment, not a full novelty claim.

gate.historical_scope: per candidate relative to deployed predecessor; report cumulative losses separately

arm_definitions.GR: reference method final state after two batches; exact question retrieval
arm_definitions.GN: proposed final state, adaptive retrieval and tool history
arm_definitions.GP: same proposed final state, no tool history supplied to controller
arm_definitions.GE: same proposed final state, exact-question retrieval, tool history retained

method.match: same visible-question intent plus exact match OR frozen text similarity above train-only cross-intent 95th percentile; rank 0.7 text cosine + 0.3 image cosine; recognizable object terms must agree for non-exact matches
method.unknown_question: require exact match for unknown intent; otherwise abstain if threshold fails
method.source: only deployed/candidate raw records with training-only image registry; no query self-reference
method.reference_order: prefer distinct corrected answers, then deterministic source-id tie break
method.image_location: reference images first; current target image last; separate explicit labels
method.scope: VQA only; historical other-task interface unchanged
method.calibration: first 24 training examples visible text/images only; no future-batch labels/images in threshold calibration
method.tool_history: per-intent tool-sequence counts, final and first-tool correctness from training only; min2 episodes per sequence; max3 sequences; no historical answers or freeform instructions to controller
method.learning_gate: policy statistics stored inside raw candidate memory, committed and rolled back together
method.feature_cost: separate timed forward-pass receipts; visible-feature cache only, no prediction cache

action_policy.key: question intent, first tool, coarse observation shape; excludes answer identity; abstain on uncertainty/long output
action_policy.utility: choose one-tool finalize only with at least 4 matched first observations and no training loss vs full two-tool; validation still requires net +1 correct
action_policy.selection_rule: one prespecified candidate, no threshold search; reject => no confirmation and no deployment
action_policy.frozen_base: parent fresh final committed state; no parent confirmation outcomes read or used
action_policy.memory_update: none; only training-derived action-policy candidate, submitted to unchanged gain/retention/format criteria
